annotations.title: IP lookup: owner, network range and country (RDAP)

description: Look up who holds an IPv4 or IPv6 address in the regional internet registries' public RDAP records (ARIN, RIPE NCC, APNIC, LACNIC, AFRINIC): the holding organisation, network name and range, allocation type, registration country, abuse contact and registry. Use to see which company or ISP a log or firewall address belongs to. Registration country, not city geolocation. Private and reserved addresses are refused with 400, uncharged. Example: ip=8.8.8.8. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: ip_lookup
